value: This abstract outlines the extensive professional engagements of a leading figure in the interdisciplinary fields of artificial life, synthetic biology, and living technology. Key roles include co-founding the European Center for Living Technology (ECLT), serving as a partner in the EU-funded Programmable Artificial Cell Evolution (PACE) program, and co-organizing the Eleventh International Conference on the Simulation and Synthesis of Living Systems (Artificial Life XI). The individual's commitment also extends to academia as a Visiting Professor, contributing to the foundational and ethical discourse within life sciences at the European School of Molecular Medicine.
